title: Canadian boards have an AI problem — what is it?
summary: Investing.com -- More than half of the companies in Canada’s S&P/TSX 60 have no board director with disclosed artificial intelligence experience, raising questions about whether corporate leaders are equipped to oversee rapidly expanding AI investments and risks, according to BMO research.
